title: 第17章 伊莉丝●潘德拉贡第18章 进入游戏
content_zh:
鹰国，塞纳西亚，塞纳斯堡
在议事大厅的中央摆放着一个2公尺ｘ2公尺的大方桌，一张与桌子一样大的地图放在桌子上面。这是艾洛西亚凭借着记忆，花了两天时间才画出来的“圣不列颠”地形图。
这份地图或许在比例上有着许多的误差，但是大致上无论是山川河水，城市道路，地形地貌，都描绘的相当清楚。艾洛西亚之所以能将这些地形地貌记得如此清楚，有赖于和”王“一同征战的那些时光，但是即使艾洛西亚尽了最大的努力，也只能绘制到这个层度而已。
艾洛西亚连同德赛斯管家，女仆长玛莉，侍卫长皮尔，站在地图的四周。
“这是我多方打听消息，然后研究绘制的地图。”艾洛西亚对着其他三人说道。
“圣不列颠？”
“没错，鹰国玩家进入”帝望“后，就出生在这个圣不列颠”。
闻言，德赛斯管家，女仆长玛莉以及侍卫长皮尔，便仔细的观看着这份地图，然后尽可能的将之记忆下来。
“这是我查到一些讯息，你们看一下。”艾洛西亚将一份资料递给了三人。这份资料是艾洛西亚从官方网站下载之后，凭着重生者的优势，将一些有纪录在官网的历史事件，一一圈划出来。
“这个圣不列颠的情况，看起来不妙阿！”侍卫长皮尔看完手上的资料后，对了对桌上的地图，他皱着眉头说道。
“是有些不妙。”女仆长玛莉指了指地图，然后说道：“你看这边，一大群迁徙而来的盎格鲁撒克逊人。照着资料来看，呵呵，他们可是相当野蛮的。”
德赛斯管家也微微的睁开了双眼，他看了看地图，片刻后将手指向了地图的某处。德赛斯管家说道：“如果没意外，他们一但有异动，一定会对这里发起攻击“接着手指沿着地图一划，又指到了另外一座城市说道：”如果他们成功占领了刚刚的那个地方，接着就一定会打这边“。
“如果那里被打了下来，整个东南部就完了。”侍卫长皮尔补充道。
“麻烦还不只这些呢。整个圣不列颠是由三个王国所组成的，南方的卡美洛特斯，北方的英格罗那，东方的苏特兰格。其中，苏特蓝格的南部已经被盎格鲁撒克逊人占领了。要是他们再往西北进攻，占领了这里“女仆长玛莉指了指地图，然后说道：”整个圣不列颠将被切成南北两段，南方的卡美洛特斯就遭殃了。”
“呵呵，这个爱德尔兰王国的国王，也不是什么好东西......”侍卫长皮尔比着地图的西边冷笑道，一个名为爱德尔兰王国的国家，隔着一段海峡与圣不列颠遥遥相对。
德赛斯管家指了指英格罗那和爱德尔兰的交界，那是一道海峡。他说道：“爱德尔兰王国如果想要扩张，只能从这里登陆英格罗那。而且我敢说，爱德尔兰一定会打英格罗那，因为天灾等因素，爱德尔兰的粮食产出可能不够了。而解决问题的最好的方法就是战争！“他顿了顿，又说道：”不管是抢到粮食，还是死于战争“。
“麻烦阿！重点是玩家会不会在爱德尔兰出生？如果会的话，很容易就变成玩家内战了。”侍卫长皮尔抓着头皮，显得有些苦恼。
艾洛西亚暗自点着头，他们的推演，基本上与记忆中相符合。虽然有她在资料上标记作为引导，但是能够这么快就推演出这些东西，便可知道他们本身的素质有多么的敏锐了。
艾洛西亚摇了摇头说道：“玩家应该不会在爱德尔兰出生。尽管照着官方给的资料，圣不列颠原本属于帝国阶层，但是因为爱德尔兰的自立，圣不列颠才分裂成卡美洛特斯，英格罗那，苏特兰格三个王国的联合性国家“。
“那如果将爱德尔兰攻下来呢？”德赛斯管家突然问道。

艾洛西亚顿了一下，眼中闪过了一丝异色，犹豫了一下后，她说道：“那圣不列颠可能会重新结合，成为一个帝国。”
一时间，德赛斯管家，女仆长玛莉，还有侍卫长皮尔，若有所思的看着地图。
“德赛斯管家，扣除必须留下来的资金以外，我们还有多少信用点？”艾洛西亚问道。
“在不影响现状为前提下，可以动用的资金部分，大概有两亿五千万。”德赛斯管家问道。
“都给我吧，我需要用到。”艾洛西亚说道。
在艾洛西亚拿到户头帐号离开后，在场的三人都沉默了。
德赛斯管家突然双眼睁大，看着地图的左边爱德尔兰王国的位置，眼中散发着杀气。他拿起了一颗标记用的棋子，放到了地图上爱德尔兰王国的中央。
“呵阿......”女仆长玛莉看着赛德斯管家的动作，有样学样也拿起了一颗棋子，放到了地图上苏格兰特王国的位置。
侍卫长皮尔摇头苦笑了一下，拿起棋子，放在了盎格鲁撒克逊人所占领的位置上。
无声之间，三人达成了某种共识。
艾洛西亚并不清楚最后发生在议事大厅里的事情，回到房间后，她便进入了她的游戏舱里面。
系统：“请问是否以自身为板模创建人物？”
“是。”
几秒后，艾洛西亚的眼前出现了一道与她一模一样的身影，打开角色的属性栏。
资质：C级
content_en:
Eagle Country, Senasia, Senasfort
In the center of the meeting hall is a large square table measuring 2 meters x 2 meters, and a map as big as the table is placed on the table. This is the topographic map of "Saint Britain" that Aelosia spent two days drawing based on her memory.
This map may have many errors in scale, but generally the mountains, rivers, urban roads, and topography are all quite clearly depicted. The reason Aelosia can remember these terrains so clearly is due to the time spent fighting with the "King", but even if Aelosia tried her best, she could only draw them to this level.
Aelosia, housekeeper Des, Mary, the head maid, and Pierre, the head guard, stood around the map.
"This is a map I drew after inquiring about information from many sources." Aelosia said to the other three people.
"Saint Britain?"
"That's right, players from the Eagle Country were born in this Holy Britain after entering "Emperor's Hope"."
Hearing this, Butler Desaise, the head maid Mary, and the head guard Pierre looked at the map carefully and memorized it as much as possible.
"This is some information I found. Please take a look." Aelosia handed a piece of information to the three of them. After Aelosia downloaded this information from the official website, with the advantage of being a reborn person, she drew out some historical events recorded on the official website one by one.
"The situation in Saint Britain doesn't look good!" Captain Pierre said with a frown after reading the information in his hand and looking at the map on the table.
"There is something wrong." Mary, the head maid, pointed at the map, and then said: "Look here, there is a large group of migrating Anglo-Saxons. Judging from the data, hehe, they are quite barbaric."
Butler Des also opened his eyes slightly. He looked at the map and after a moment pointed his finger somewhere on the map. Steward Dessais said: "If nothing unexpected happens, they will definitely attack here if there is any abnormal movement." Then he traced his finger along the map and pointed to another city and said: "If they successfully occupy the place just now, they will definitely attack here."
"If it is defeated there, the entire southeast will be finished." Pierre, the captain of the guard, added.
"That's not all the trouble. The entire Saint Britain is composed of three kingdoms, Camelots in the south, Engrona in the north, and Sutranga in the east. Among them, the southern part of Sutranga has been occupied by the Anglo-Saxons. If they attack further northwest and occupy this place," the head maid Mary pointed at the map, and then said: "The entire Saint Britain will be divided into two parts, north and south, and Camelots in the south will suffer."
"Haha, this king of the Kingdom of Adelland is not a good person..." Captain Pierre pointed to the west side of the map and sneered. A country called the Kingdom of Adelland was far away from St. Britain across a strait.
Steward Desais pointed to the border between Ingelona and Edelland, which is a strait. He said: "If the Kingdom of Edelland wants to expand, it can only land in Inglona from here. And I dare say that Edelland will definitely attack Inglona. Due to natural disasters and other factors, Edelland's food output may not be enough. And the best way to solve the problem is war!" He paused, and then said: "Whether you grab food or die in the war."
"Trouble! The important point is, will the player be born in Edelland? If so, it will easily become a civil war among the players." Guard Captain Pierre scratched his scalp, looking a little distressed.
Aelosia nodded secretly. Their deduction was basically consistent with their memory. Although she marked the information as a guide, being able to deduce these things so quickly was a big surprise.You know how sharp their own qualities are.
Aelosia shook her head and said: "The player should not have been born in Edelland. Although according to the official information, Saint Britain originally belonged to the imperial class, but because of Edelland's independence, Saint Britain was split into the three kingdoms of Camelots, Ingrona, and Sutranger."
"What if Edelland is captured?" Butler Dess suddenly asked.
Aelosia paused, a strange look flashed in her eyes, and after hesitating, she said: "Then Saint Britain may reunite and become an empire."
For a moment, Butler Des, the head maid Mary, and the head guard Pierre looked at the map thoughtfully.
"Butler Des, how many credits do we have after deducting the funds that must be left?" Aelosia asked.
"On the premise of not affecting the current situation, the amount of funds that can be used is about 250 million." Butler Des asked.
"Give it all to me, I need it." Aelosia said.
After Aelosia got the account number and left, the three people present fell silent.
Butler Dess suddenly opened his eyes wide and looked at the location of the Kingdom of Edelland on the left side of the map, with murderous intent exuding in his eyes. He picked up a marking chess piece and placed it in the center of the Kingdom of Edelland on the map.
"Haha..." Mary, the head maid, looked at Steward Sedes's actions and imitated the chess piece, picking up a chess piece and placing it on the map at the location of the Kingdom of Scotland.
Captain Pierre shook his head and smiled bitterly, picked up the chess piece and placed it on the position occupied by the Anglo-Saxons.
Silently, the three of them reached some kind of consensus.
Aelosia didn't know what happened in the meeting hall in the end. After returning to the room, she entered her game cabin.
System: "Would you like to use yourself as a template to create a character?"
"Yes."
A few seconds later, a figure exactly like her appeared in front of Aelosia's eyes, and he opened the character's attribute bar.
Qualification: C level
